note: Single-receptor structures for Stage 2 de novo peptide binder design. Native binding partners and solvent molecules have been removed. Residue numbering preserves original PDB author numbering.

targets.name: Human Interleukin-7 Receptor Subunit Alpha (IL-7Rα)
targets.biological_objective: Design de novo linear and head-to-tail cyclic peptide binders (5–20 aa, standard L-amino acids excluding Cys) that block the interaction between IL-7Rα and its native cytokine ligand IL-7.

targets.name: Human Tropomyosin Receptor Kinase A (TrkA, Ig-like domain d5)
targets.biological_objective: Design de novo linear and head-to-tail cyclic peptide binders (5–20 aa, standard L-amino acids excluding Cys) that block the interaction between TrkA and its native neurotrophin ligand β-NGF.

targets.name: Human Programmed Cell Death 1 Ligand 1 (PD-L1, IgV domain)
targets.biological_objective: Design de novo linear and head-to-tail cyclic peptide binders (5–20 aa, standard L-amino acids excluding Cys) that block the interaction between PD-L1 and its native receptor PD-1.
